outcomes: The Cloud cache provider resolves the remote cache configuration and the materialization mode of a session, and tells the core the mode it resolved
nonGoals: Changing how the provider reads .putnami/cache.json, the PUTNAMI_CACHE_* variables or the default of a linked workspace
A new protocol version. provider-configuration is a capability of the initialize payload

requirements.text: The session mode is the core's intent, else the configured mode, else minimal for a hosted launch and full otherwise.

text: A restore of a hit's files negotiates its key in a mode that names downloads: the session mode, or full when the session is minimal.
Only the keys core restores result-only are negotiated in minimal.
Setup and install write a mode into .putnami/cache.json only when --cache-mode or PUTNAMI_CACHE_MODE requests one.
A run whose file records no mode resolves minimal when hosted and full otherwise.
A file that records a mode keeps it.

requirements.text: A session with an active remote cache prints the mode it resolved, and where the mode comes from, once on stderr.
